title: DID NOT WORK
text: DID NOT WORK. How can amazon send such garbage out? I received this item broken. Something was rattling around inside the unit. A screw was missing. The sound would not work. Had to send it back. I knew it was too good to be true because the price was reasonable, 79.99, usually 149.00. I had really wanted this for my granddaughter to see and hear. I am so disappointed, really wanted this unit.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Christmas Outdoor Lights and Sounds of Christmas Holiday Decoration Power Strip Stake, Plays 20 Songs, 6 Outlets
features: All-in-one outdoor light and sound system synchronizes yard lights with 20 holiday songs
Onboard speaker has full volume control and options to play songs randomly, select songs, and skip songs
Clear weatherized cases protect from moisture and dirt; UL Listed for outdoor use
description: The first and best light show creator in the market, the original Outdoor Lights and Sounds from Mr. Christmas will wow the whole neighborhood. Connect up to six separate lights strands to the control box to create a synchronized light show in synch to the music. Three light settings - Multiplex (a dynamic moving light show), Unison (all lights blinking) or Steady On. Connect thousands of lights (1440 watts/12A max) and cover your house or yard. Can be used with any type of adapter operated light string such as LED or incandescent. Volume control can be used to play as loud or as soft as you like. UL listed outdoor safe adapter. The Outdoor Lights and Sounds will turn your outdoor lights into a musical light show to entertain your friends and family.
